headline: Flash-dLLM reports faster diffusion-model decoding with fused KV caching and self-verification
summary: A September 2026 paper proposes Flash-Cache, which fuses KV-cache operations, and Flash-Verify, which lets a diffusion LLM draft and verify candidate tokens without an auxiliary model. On one NVIDIA A100 80GB running LLaDA-1.5, the authors report 5.1× speedup over Elastic-Cache on GSM8K at 512 tokens and 11.0× on HumanEval at 512 tokens. Across the paper’s 512-token settings, reported throughput reaches 210.6 tokens/s on GSM8K, 210.1 on MATH, 185.6 on HumanEval and 148.2 on MBPP; accuracy varies by task, and the fastest setting is not always the most accurate. The authors provide an Apache-2.0 repository with benchmark scripts, but no code was run; its README flags a possible difference between paper and adapter descriptions of the verification threshold. These remain author-reported results from one model and hardware setup.
